summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-05: no newly verified AI-specific labor-market evidence materially changes Career Radar. BLS October payroll release is scheduled for 2026-11-06 at 08:30 ET (after this check); Nov 5 unemployment claims and productivity data are aggregate observed labor-market measures, not evidence of AI-caused displacement. Recent media coverage of a Goldman Sachs displacement analysis lacks independently verified primary methodology for intake; existing IMF/ILO/OECD/BLS findings are not duplicated.
